purpose: Bind the already-frozen G5/G6 diagnostic authority to the fresh replacement cohort's measured pre-life G2 ceiling without changing any final-life outcome, because no replacement life has been generated yet.

observedMismatch.oldEmpiricalAssumption: The original G6 treated measured pair 3-4 as a low/inconclusive G2 edge and excluded it from the blocking D3 propagation core.
observedMismatch.freshReplacementEvidence: Fresh replacement pair 3-4 scored 24/24 and is strong_ceiling_signal, and all five measured cycle edges are detectable.
observedMismatch.requiredConsequence: The old pair-3-4 exemption cannot be silently applied to the replacement genomes. The replacement D3 blocking core must use all five measured edges.

g6D3EffectiveRule.edgeDecision: Use the exact frozen G5 matched-vs-swapped rank-point decision at each fixed ordinal on all five measured G2 cycle edges.

directPropagationClearRequirement.equivalentStatement: Both fixed ordinals must be at least 4/5 on the five G2-detectable edges, and at least one ordinal must be 5/5.

g6D3EffectiveRule.directPropagationHoldRule: If the direct-propagation clear requirement is not met => HOLD; never regenerate, move treatment positions, rewrite genomes, or exclude an inconvenient measured edge.

chanceReferenceOnly.note: Reference arithmetic only. Shared genomes, model behavior, and repeated cohort membership mean independence is not asserted.

nonAdaptivity.thresholdTranslationBasis: Use the already-frozen G5 five-edge bands and preserve the old G6 structure of requiring a strong/suggestive result at both fixed ordinals plus a perfect result at at least one ordinal. With all five edges now ceiling-eligible, this becomes >=4/5 at both ordinals and 5/5 at at least one ordinal.

authorizationBoundary.onGateHoldOrRedesign: Do not generate replacement lives. Preserve this reconciliation and all fresh G2 evidence; make only an explicitly reviewed pre-life correction if warranted.
